memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Psoriasis: Status - plaques on elbows and knees, mild itch. Plan - continue clobetasol 0.05% cream BD, calcipotriol ointment OD, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly with folic acid 5 mg OD; review LFT in 6 weeks.
Epilepsy: Status - seizure-free on levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD. Plan - maintain current regimen; check serum sodium if symptoms.
NAFLD: Status - asymptomatic, BMI 27. Plan - silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD; repeat LFT and lipid profile in 3 months.
Weight 68 kg, waist 84 cm (female cutoff 80 cm) – central obesity.
Diet advice: Breakfast - idli with sambar, limited oil; Lunch - vegetable curry with roti, small portion rice; Dinner - steamed vegetables, avoid fried snacks.
Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
clobetasol 0.05% cream apply BD to affected areas
calcipotriol ointment apply OD to plaques
methotrexate 7.5 mg take once weekly on Monday
folic acid 5 mg take OD
levetiracetam 500 mg take BD
lamotrigine 50 mg take BD
silymarin 140 mg take TDS
rosuvastatin 5 mg take OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:

Serum creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL (0.6-1.1)
All within normal limits.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: EEG: Background activity normal for age. No epileptiform discharges or slowing seen. No evidence of seizure focus.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:

Epilepsy: Status - seizure-free. Plan - continue levetiracetam and lamotrigine.
NAFLD: Status - LFT stable. Plan - continue silymarin and rosuvastatin; repeat LFT and lipid profile.
Weight 67.5 kg, waist 83 cm (still >80 cm).
Diet advice: Breakfast - poha with peanuts, limited oil; Lunch - mixed vegetable curry with chapati, small rice; Dinner - grilled fish, salad.
Due: HbA1c 2025-10-01.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Noticed increased redness and itching on scalp and elbows over past week. Applying clobetasol helps but plaques seem thicker. No new seizures. Appetite normal.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Refer to Dermatology for evaluation of refractory psoriasis plaques despite topical steroids and methotrexate. Consider phototherapy or systemic agent. Please advise on safety given concurrent epilepsy meds.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Dermatology review: Psoriasis moderate-to-severe. Recommend narrowband UVB thrice weekly; continue methotrexate with LFT monitoring. No contraindication with levetiracetam/lamotrigine. Follow up in 6 weeks.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Psoriasis: Status - after 8 weeks UVB, plaques thinner, less itch. Plan - continue UVB twice weekly, maintain methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly.
Epilepsy: Status - seizure-free. Plan - continue current AEDs.
NAFLD: Status - LFT ALT 38 U/L now normal. Plan - continue silymarin and rosuvastatin; repeat lipid profile annually.
Weight 66 kg, waist 80 cm (at cutoff).
Diet advice: Breakfast - upma with veggies, limited oil; Lunch - dal with brown rice, vegetable side; Dinner - lentil soup, steamed greens.
Due: HbA1c 2026-04-05.

memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) for 2026-04-05 at 10:30 AM. Please bring recent LFT and UVB schedule.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Psoriasis: Status - plaques minimal, maintained on UVB twice weekly and methotrexate. Plan - taper UVB to once weekly, continue methotrexate.
Epilepsy: Status - seizure-free for over a year. Plan - consider lamotrigine taper if EEG remains normal; discuss with neurology.
NAFLD: Status - LFT normal, lipid profile within target. Plan - continue silymarin and rosuvastatin; repeat LFT in 6 months.
Weight 65 kg, waist 78 cm (<80 cm).
Diet advice: Breakfast - vegetable oats, Lunch - chickpea curry with quinoa, Dinner - vegetable stir-fry with tofu.
Due: HbA1c 2027-01-10 (patient not on glucose-lowering; recorded for completeness).
